t6123.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Muḥammad ibn ʿUbayd, brother of Saʿīd, as unknown and of the fifth generation.

t6156.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Shāfiʿ al-Muṭṭalibī al-Makkī, of the seventh generation; al-Shāfiʿī declared him trustworthy.

t6372.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd al-Zubaydī al-Ḥimṣī, Abū al-Hudhayl, a judge, as trustworthy and reliable, one of the senior companions of al-Zuhrī, of the seventh generation, who died in 46, 47, or 49.
as: ثقة ثبت من كبار أصحاب الزهري
Trustworthy, reliable, one of the senior companions of al-Zuhrī
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
وكل هؤلاء ثقات، والزبيدي أثبت من سفيان بن عيينة
All in this group are reliable and al-Zubaydī is firmer in al-Zuhrī's hadith than Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah.
وقال العجلي ، وعلي بن المديني ، وأبو زرعة الرازي ، والنسائي: ثقة. زاد علي: ثبت
Al-ʿIjlī, ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī and al-Nasāʾī: reliable; ʿAlī added: firm.
كان أعلم أهل الشام بالفتوى، والحديث، وكان ثقة إن شاء الله
He was the most learned Syrian in fatwa and hadith, and reliable, God willing.
شعيب بن أبي خمزة ثقة، ثبت يشبه حديثه حديث عقيل، والزبيدي فوقه
Shuʿayb is reliable and firm, and al-Zubaydī is above him.
محمد بن عوف الطائي, quoted by al-Mizzī
الزبيدي من ثقات المسلمين، وإذا جاءك الزبيدي عن الزهري، فاستمسك به
Al-Zubaydī is among the reliable Muslims; when he narrates from al-Zuhrī, hold fast to it.
لم يكن في أصحاب الزهري أثبت من الزبيدي
None of al-Zuhrī's companions was firmer than al-Zubaydī.
There is no error in his hadith.
He was among the precise memorisers.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
هو مثلهم. يعني: يونس، وعقيل بن خالد، وشعيب بن أبي حمزة
On al-Zuhrī he is like Yūnus, ʿUqayl and Shuʿayb.
يفضل محمد بن الوليد الزبيدي على جميع من سمع من الزهري
He preferred al-Zubaydī over everyone who heard from al-Zuhrī.
وقد احتوى ما بين جنبي من العلم
He has absorbed the knowledge I hold within me.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
Reliable. ʿAlī added that he was firm.
وأبو زرعة الرازي, quoted by al-Mizzī
وكان ثقة إن شاء الله. وكان أعلم أهل الشام بالفتوى والحديث
He was reliable, God willing, and the most knowledgeable Syrian in legal opinions and hadith.
وكان أعلم أهل الشام بالفتوى والحديث
He was the most learned of the people of Syria in legal rulings and hadith.

t7230.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Hārūn ibn Saʿīd al-Aylī al-Saʿdī, Abū Jaʿfar, resident of Egypt, as trustworthy and virtuous, of the tenth generation, who died in the year two hundred and fifty-three at the age of eighty-three.
as: Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
There is no objection to him.
Ibn Ḥibbān included him in The Reliable Transmitters.
وكان ثقة، وكانت سنه قد علت وضعف، ولزم بيته.
He was reliable. In advanced age he grew weak and stayed at home.
أبو عمر محمد بن يوسف الكندي, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان فقيها من أصحاب ابن وهب
He was a jurist and one of Ibn Wahb’s associates.

t7793.bio: Ibn Ḥajar describes Yazīd ibn Abī Yazīd al-Ḍubʿī, known as al-Rashk, as trustworthy and devout, of the sixth generation, who died in 30 AH at the age of one hundred.
as: Trustworthy and devout; those who weakened him erred.

t7906.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Yūnus ibn Sayf al-Kalāʿī al-Ḥimṣī as acceptable, of the fourth generation, and notes that whoever named him Yūsuf erred.

t7973.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Abū Bakr ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Sabrah al-Qurashī al-ʿĀmirī al-Madanī, accused of fabricating hadith though Muṣʿab al-Zubayrī deemed him a scholar; of the seventh generation, died in 62 (without hundreds).
as: They accused him of fabricating hadith.

t8077.bio: Ibn Ḥajar reports Abū Khuzāmah ibn Yaʿmar al-Saʿdī, one of the Banū al-Ḥārith ibn Saʿd ibn Hudhaym, as a Companion who has a hadith on ruqyah that some transmitters inverted; the names Zayd ibn al-Ḥārith and al-Ḥārith are both erroneous.
